objective: Convert the Diwali runway into the year's biggest renewal month: 3 Months and 6 Months sales at festival prices, family gifting that brings genuinely new people in, and October starts that survive November's travel.
strategy:
Festival of Lights.

Commercial job: Convert the Diwali runway into the year's biggest renewal month: 3 Months and 6 Months sales at festival prices, family gifting that brings genuinely new people in, and October starts that survive November's travel.

Newcomer: Gift a Flight (“Give someone a flight of classes. Three months, 20% off.”). Diwali gifting is the one moment people will buy a membership for someone else; a 3-month gift at 20% is the natural unit.

Newcomer: Pay It Forward (“Gift a month to someone who's never been. You get a fortnight.”). Members already refer; Diwali makes the ask normal. The member's reward unlocks only when the friend buys, so it stays acquisition spend.

Winback: Come Home for Diwali (“Come home for the festival. Stay for the habit. 20% off.”). Diwali is the one week families regroup in Mumbai; lapsed clients are in town and sentimental.

Renewal: Light Years Ahead (“Six months, 22% off, through Holi.”). Members who commit through the festival season skip the November–January lapse cycle, and the ticket lands before the year closes.
notes:
Moment: Festival of Lights: the Diwali gift desk (a wrapped gift card and a handwritten note with every gift purchase), the annual 'One Light' partner class raising money for a Mumbai charity, and the Diwali-week short-class timetable (29 Oct).
Build: new clients 42 buyers = ₹4.8L; reactivation 39 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.5L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹4.2L; renewals ₹26.0L. First visits needed 134; CRM leads needed 167.

items.detail: Set up Gift a Flight in Momence (1–31 Oct.): 3 Months Unlimited, gifted, at 20% off (₹46,284) — a wrapped gift card, a handwritten note and a free first class for the recipient.

Set up Pay It Forward in Momence (1–31 Oct.): You buy a month for someone who has never trained at P57 — 1 Month at 20% off (₹16,191) for them; when they buy their own month within 30 days you get +14 days.
Set up Come Home for Diwali in Momence (1–31 Oct.): 1 Month Unlimited at 20% off (₹16,191) or 3 Months at 22% off (₹45,127) — a Diwali gift box and 2 bonus classes.
Set up Light Years Ahead in Momence (1–30 Nov.): 6 Months Unlimited at 22% off (₹88,698) — a freeze bank of 10 days through the festival season and a seat in the 2028 Kickstart cohort.
Brief the team on the 4 October offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Gift a Flight to Members and clients gifting at Diwali.
Launch Pay It Forward to Active members with a friend who's never trained.
Launch Come Home for Diwali to Lapsed clients.
Launch Light Years Ahead to Members expiring Oct–Dec.

Run the month's moment: Festival of Lights — the Diwali gift desk (a wrapped gift card and a handwritten note with every gift purchase), the annual 'One Light' partner class raising money for a Mumbai charity, and the Diwali-week short-class timetable.

Weekly check: Gift a Flight: Gift cards sold; recipients activating (target 70%). | Pay It Forward: Gifts bought; friend purchase within 30 days. | Come Home for Diwali: Lapsed purchases; bonus class usage. | Light Years Ahead: 6M share of renewals (target 30%).
Mid-month review against ₹39.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 168 renewals, 60 reactivations and 46 new buyers (150 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Run the 'One Light' charity class and publish the amount raised; photograph the gift desk for the December Wrapped recap.
Close October: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief November's offers.
